# Generated by westminster/tools/data/build_seat_leans.py - edit there.


# Polls start from the 2024 result.
wm_polls_init_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_lab value = wm_polls_2024_lab }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_con value = wm_polls_2024_con }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_ld value = wm_polls_2024_ld }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_ruk value = wm_polls_2024_ruk }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_grn value = wm_polls_2024_grn }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_snp value = wm_polls_2024_snp }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_pc value = wm_polls_2024_pc }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_sf value = wm_polls_2024_sf }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_dup value = wm_polls_2024_dup }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_sdlp value = wm_polls_2024_sdlp }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_apni value = wm_polls_2024_apni }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_uup value = wm_polls_2024_uup }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_tuv value = wm_polls_2024_tuv }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_poll_oth value = wm_polls_2024_oth }
}

# A month of poll movement for every party (wm_polls_drift_party_effect), then back to a total of 1000.
wm_polls_drift_all_effect = {
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = lab }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = con }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = ld }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = ruk }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = grn }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = snp }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = pc }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = sf }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = dup }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = sdlp }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = apni }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = uup }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = tuv }
	wm_polls_drift_party_effect = { P = oth }
	wm_polls_normalise_effect = yes
}

wm_polls_normalise_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_polls_sum value = wm_polls_total }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:wm_polls_sum > 0 }
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_lab
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_lab
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_con
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_con
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_ld
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_ld
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_ruk
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_ruk
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_grn
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_grn
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_snp
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_snp
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_pc
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_pc
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_sf
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_sf
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_dup
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_dup
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_sdlp
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_sdlp
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_apni
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_apni
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_uup
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_uup
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_tuv
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_tuv
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = wm_poll_oth
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_poll_oth
				multiply = 1000
				divide = global_var:wm_polls_sum
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a seat. Scores every party that stood there in 2024 (wm_election_score_party_effect).
wm_election_score_parties_effect = {
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = lab PARTY = k_party_labour }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = con PARTY = k_party_conservative }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = ld PARTY = k_party_lib_dem }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = ruk PARTY = k_party_reform }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = grn PARTY = k_party_green }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = snp PARTY = k_party_snp }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = pc PARTY = k_party_plaid }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = sf PARTY = k_party_sinn_fein }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = dup PARTY = k_party_dup }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = sdlp PARTY = k_party_sdlp }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = apni PARTY = k_party_alliance }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = uup PARTY = k_party_uup }
	wm_election_score_party_effect = { P = tuv PARTY = k_party_tuv }
}

# Seats per party into global_var:wm_seats_<party> (plus _ind for independents and _spk for the Speaker).
wm_election_count_seats_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_lab value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_con value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ld value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ruk value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_grn value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_snp value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_pc value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_sf value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_dup value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_sdlp value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_apni value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_uup value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_tuv value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ind value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_spk value = 0 }
	title:e_united_kingdom = {
		every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				exists = holder
			}
			holder = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_labour }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_lab add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_conservative }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_con add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_lib_dem }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ld add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_reform }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ruk add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_green }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_grn add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_snp }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_snp add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_plaid }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_pc add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sinn_fein }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_sf add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_dup }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_dup add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sdlp }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_sdlp add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_alliance }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_apni add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_uup }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_uup add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_tuv }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_tuv add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_character_flag = wm_speaker }
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_spk add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					change_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_ind add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Remember the seat counts before an election (for gains and losses).
wm_election_copy_prev_seats_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_lab value = global_var:wm_seats_lab }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_con value = global_var:wm_seats_con }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_ld value = global_var:wm_seats_ld }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_ruk value = global_var:wm_seats_ruk }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_grn value = global_var:wm_seats_grn }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_snp value = global_var:wm_seats_snp }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_pc value = global_var:wm_seats_pc }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_sf value = global_var:wm_seats_sf }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_dup value = global_var:wm_seats_dup }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_sdlp value = global_var:wm_seats_sdlp }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_apni value = global_var:wm_seats_apni }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_uup value = global_var:wm_seats_uup }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_tuv value = global_var:wm_seats_tuv }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_ind value = global_var:wm_seats_ind }
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_seats_prev_spk value = global_var:wm_seats_spk }
}

# The largest party: global_var:wm_el_largest (party title) and wm_el_largest_seats. A tie goes to the PM's party.
wm_election_find_largest_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_lab > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_lab = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_labour }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_labour }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_lab }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_con > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_con = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_conservative }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_conservative }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_con }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_ld > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_ld = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_lib_dem }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_lib_dem }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_ld }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_ruk > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_ruk = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_reform }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_reform }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_ruk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_grn > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_grn = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_green }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_green }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_grn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_snp > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_snp = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_snp }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_snp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_snp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_pc > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_pc = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_plaid }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_plaid }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_pc }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_sf > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_sf = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sinn_fein }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_sinn_fein }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_sf }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_dup > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_dup = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_dup }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_dup }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_dup }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_sdlp > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_sdlp = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_sdlp }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_sdlp }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_sdlp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_apni > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_apni = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_alliance }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_alliance }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_apni }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_uup > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_uup = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_uup }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_uup }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_uup }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:wm_seats_tuv > global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				AND = {
					global_var:wm_seats_tuv = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
					title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_tuv }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest value = title:k_party_tuv }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_el_largest_seats value = global_var:wm_seats_tuv }
	}
}

# Every party leader without a seat (MPs are handled by wm_election_rewire_effect) serves the Prime Minister. Needs scope:wm_el_rewire (a title and
# vassal change) and scope:wm_el_pm.
wm_election_party_leaders_serve_pm_effect = {
	title:k_party_labour.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_conservative.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_lib_dem.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_reform.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_green.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_snp.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_plaid.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_sinn_fein.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
		}
	}
	title:k_party_dup.holder ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:wm_el_pm }
				NOT = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { liege ?= scope:wm_el_pm }
			}
			change_liege = { liege = scope:wm_el_pm change = scope:wm_el_rewire }
